W=H=360;bpp=3;st=W*bpp

        if f==1:line[i]=(line[i]+a)&255
        elif f==2:line[i]=(line[i]+b)&255
        elif f==3:line[i]=(line[i]+(a+b)//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)

def pack(bits,order):
    r=bytearray()

        v=0
        for j in range(8):
            v=(v<<1|bits[i+j]) if order=='big' else (v|bits[i+j]<<j)
        r.append(v)
    return bytes(r)
for name,sl in [('r',px[0::3]),('g',px[1::3]),('b',px[2::3]),('rgb',px)]:
  for bit in range(3):
    bits=[(x>>bit)&1 for x in sl]
    for o in ('big','little'):
        b=pack(bits,o)
